heading.en: Which part of a mango do we eat?

hook.en: We eat the juicy middle of a mango but throw away the hard stone. In a coconut, the fibres we make ropes from are the same layer as the mango pulp.
hook.kn: ಮಾವಿನ ರಸಭರಿತ ಮಧ್ಯ ಭಾಗ ತಿಂದು ಗಟ್ಟಿ ಓಟೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಸಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ. ತೆಂಗಿನ ನಾರು ಕೂಡ ಮಾವಿನ ತಿರುಳಿನಂತೆಯೇ ಅದೇ ಪದರ.

objectives.en: Describe the parts of a fruit and a drupe
Compare a dicot seed with a monocot seed
Recognise Fabaceae, Solanaceae and Liliaceae from their floral formulae

narration.en: We eat the juicy middle of a mango but throw away the hard stone. In a coconut, the fibres we make ropes from are the same layer as the mango pulp.

body.en: The fruit is the mature or ripened ovary formed after fertilisation. A fruit formed without fertilisation is parthenocarpic. The fruit wall, the pericarp, has an outer epicarp, a middle mesocarp and an inner endocarp. In mango and coconut the fruit is a drupe, developing from a monocarpellary superior ovary and one-seeded. In mango the mesocarp is fleshy and edible and the endocarp stony; in coconut the mesocarp is fibrous.
body.kn: ಹಣ್ಣು ಫಲೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರ ಪಕ್ವವಾದ ಅಂಡಾಶಯ. ಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಹ್ಯಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿ, ಮಧ್ಯಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿ, ಅಂತರ್ಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿ. ಮಾವು ಮತ್ತು ತೆಂಗು ಡ್ರೂಪ್; ಮಾವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿ ತಿನ್ನುವ ಭಾಗ, ತೆಂಗಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರು.

narration.en: After fertilisation the petals fall, the ovary wall grows into the pericarp and the ovules become seeds. In a mango (a drupe) the pericarp is an outer epicarp, a fleshy mesocarp and a hard, stony endocarp around one seed; a tomato (a berry) is fleshy throughout with many seeds. Without fertilisation the flower drops off, unless the fruit forms by parthenocarpy, which gives seedless fruit as in banana.
narration.kn: ನಿಷೇಚನದ ನಂತರ ದಳಗಳು ಉದುರುತ್ತವೆ, ಅಂಡಾಶಯದ ಭಿತ್ತಿ ಫಲಭಿತ್ತಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಡಕಗಳು ಬೀಜಗಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಮಾವಿನಲ್ಲಿ (ಡ್ರೂಪ್) ಹೊರಭಿತ್ತಿ, ತಿರುಳಿನ ಮಧ್ಯಭಿತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಬೀಜದ ಸುತ್ತ ಗಟ್ಟಿ ಒಳಭಿತ್ತಿ; ಟೊಮ್ಯಾಟೊ (ಬೆರ್ರಿ) ಪೂರ್ತಿ ತಿರುಳಿದ್ದು ಅನೇಕ ಬೀಜಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ನಿಷೇಚನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹೂವು ಉದುರುತ್ತದೆ, ಅನಿಷೇಕ ಫಲನ (ಬಾಳೆಯಂತೆ ಬೀಜರಹಿತ) ಹೊರತು.

title.en: On the board: Fruit, seed and some important families

say.en: A mango is a drupe: one seed, from a single-carpel superior ovary.
The fruit wall has three layers: epicarp, mesocarp and endocarp.
In coconut, also a drupe, the mesocarp is fibrous.
A floral formula sums up a flower. Fabaceae: zygomorphic, vexillary corolla, diadelphous stamens, one carpel.
Solanaceae: regular, five fused sepals and petals, epipetalous stamens, two fused carpels.
Liliaceae: six tepals in two whorls, six stamens, three fused carpels.
Brackets mean fused; a line under G means a superior ovary.

narration.en: Sort the plants and the floral features into the right family.

prompt.en: Sort each plant or floral feature into its family.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಸ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಹೂವಿನ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Perianth of six tepals in two whorls

explanation.en: Fabaceae (pea family) gives pulses and edible oils; Solanaceae (potato family) gives vegetables and drugs; Liliaceae (lily family) is a monocot family of ornamentals and medicines (colchicine).

body.en: A dicot seed such as gram or pea has a seed coat with an outer testa and inner tegmen, a hilum scar where it was attached to the fruit, a micropyle, and an embryo with an axis and two cotyledons. Monocot seeds are generally endospermic. In maize the seed coat is fused with the fruit wall, the bulky endosperm stores food and is separated from the embryo by a protein-rich aleurone layer. The single shield-shaped cotyledon is the scutellum, and the plumule and radicle are enclosed in sheaths called the coleoptile and the coleorhiza.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಬೀಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಟೆಸ್ಟಾ, ಟೆಗ್ಮೆನ್, ಹೈಲಮ್, ಮೈಕ್ರೋಪೈಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಬೀಜದಳಗಳು. ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲ್ಯೂರೋನ್ ಪದರ, ಸ್ಕ್ಯೂಟೆಲಮ್ ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಬೀಜದಳ; ಪ್ರಾಂಕುರಕ್ಕೆ ಕೋಲಿಯೋಪ್ಟೈಲ್, ಭ್ರೂಣಮೂಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕೋಲಿಯೋರೈಜಾ ಕವಚ.

points.en: Dicot: testa, tegmen, hilum, two cotyledons
Coleoptile covers plumule; coleorhiza covers radicle

body.en: A floral formula summarises a flower: K calyx, C corolla, P perianth, A androecium, G gynoecium, brackets for fusion, and a line under G for a superior ovary. Fabaceae (pea): zygomorphic, vexillary corolla, diadelphous stamens (9) + 1, monocarpellary superior ovary with marginal placentation. Solanaceae (brinjal, tomato, potato): actinomorphic, five fused sepals and petals, five epipetalous stamens, bicarpellary syncarpous superior ovary with axile placentation and a swollen placenta. Liliaceae (lily, onion, Asparagus): trimerous, six tepals in two whorls, six stamens, tricarpellary syncarpous superior ovary with axile placentation.
body.kn: ಹೂ ಸೂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ K ಪುಷ್ಪಪಾತ್ರೆ, C ದಳಪುಂಜ, P ಪರಿಪುಷ್ಪ, A ಪುಂಕೇಸರ, G ಸ್ತ್ರೀಕೇಸರ. ಫ್ಯಾಬೇಸೀ: ದ್ವಿಸಂಘ ಪುಂಕೇಸರ (9)+1. ಸೊಲನೇಸೀ: ದ್ವಿಶಲಾಕಾ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ, ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಜರಾಯು. ಲಿಲಿಯೇಸೀ: ಆರು ಟೆಪಲ್‌ಗಳು, ತ್ರಿಶಲಾಕಾ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ.

problem.en: A flower has the formula ⊕ P(3+3) A3+3 G(3) with a superior ovary. Identify the family and explain each symbol.

steps.en: ⊕ means actinomorphic; P(3+3) means six tepals in two whorls of three, fused.
A3+3 means six stamens in two whorls; G(3) means three fused carpels, and the superior ovary is shown by the line under G.
A trimerous flower with a perianth and a tricarpellary syncarpous ovary belongs to Liliaceae.
